content_units: Madrid–Athens Flight Snapshot
For a leisure trip within your   EUR 700 total budget   for   2 adults  , all 4 options fit. The best ranking depends mainly on your trade-off between   comfort/time   and   price  .
Ranked Flight Options
Airline   Departure   Arrival   Duration   Stops   Fare
Option 1   09:10 AM   01:25 PM   4h 15m   Non-stop   EUR 612
Option 3   04:00 PM   08:10 PM   4h 10m   1 stop   EUR 688
Option 2   06:20 AM   12:50 PM   6h 30m   1 stop   EUR 540
Option 4   10:30 PM   08:15 AM   9h 45m   1 stop   EUR 470
1)   Option 1 — Best overall / best comfort choice
-   Why it ranks first:   nonstop both ways, good daytime timings, and still comfortably under budget.
-   Outbound:   09:10–13:25 is easy for a leisure trip and avoids a very early airport start.
-   Return:   18:40–21:10 gives you most of the final day in Athens.
-   Value trade-off:   it costs   EUR 72 more than Option 2  , but saves you connections both ways and reduces travel stress.
2)   Option 3 — Premium convenience if seat selection matters
-   Why it ranks second:   strong outbound comfort with a nonstop flight and   seat selection included  .
-   Trade-off:   return has   1 stop  , and it is the most expensive option after still remaining under budget.
-   Best for:   travelers who care about reserving seats in advance and are okay paying more for that certainty.
3)   Option 2 — Best value choice
-   Why it ranks third overall but wins on value:   at   EUR 540  , it saves   EUR 72 vs Option 1   and   EUR 148 vs Option 3  .
-   Trade-off:   1 stop each way plus a very early   06:20   outbound and   07:00   return.
-   Best for:   budget-conscious travelers who are fine with longer airport/transit time to keep total trip cost lower.
4)   Option 4 — Cheapest, but weakest for a leisure trip
-   Why it ranks last:   although cheapest at   EUR 470  , the outbound is the least pleasant:   22:30 departure arriving 08:15 next day   with a stop.
-   Trade-off:   you likely lose sleep and arrive tired, which can reduce the first day of your holiday.
-   Upside:   nonstop return is nice, but not enough to offset the awkward outbound.
Best Value vs Best Comfort
Best value choice: Option 2
- Lowest-cost option that still keeps timings reasonable enough for most travelers.
- Savings of   EUR 72   compared with Option 1 may be worth it if you would rather spend that on hotels, food, or activities in Athens.
- Main downside is the   extra connection time both ways   and very early departures.
Best comfort choice: Option 1
- Clearly the smoothest itinerary:   nonstop both ways  , no overnight disruption, and practical flight times.
- Better trip quality overall, especially for a short leisure break where wasted time matters.
- At   EUR 612 total  , it stays well below your   EUR 700 ceiling  , so the comfort upgrade is not excessive.
Booking Recommendation
If you want the smartest all-around pick, choose   Option 1  . It gives the best mix of   comfort, schedule quality, and still-reasonable price  .
If your top priority is minimizing spend, choose   Option 2  . It is the   best value   as long as you accept the early starts and connections.
